{{Short description|Italian biologist, writer, and television presenter (born 1946)}}
[[File:Luigi Boitani.png|thumb|Luigi Boitani in 2014]]
'''Luigi Boitani''' (born April 2, 1946, in [[Rome]]) is a professor of [[zoology]] at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]],<ref>''[https://web.uniroma1.it/sssas/node/5826 Luigi Boitani Professore Ordinario di Zoologia]''</ref> whose research interests include [[ecology]], the protection of large [[mammal]]s, and the management of protected areas. Boitani is president of the [[Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe]].

== Life and work ==
Boitani is a professor of [[conservation biology]] and animal ecology and was head of the Department of Zoology and Human Biology at the Sapienza University of Rome<ref>'' [http://biodiversity-group.huji.ac.il/SalitKark/sciencebasedconservationworkshopboitani.html Science-Based Conservation Workshop People] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121013001956/http://biodiversity-group.huji.ac.il/SalitKark/sciencebasedconservationworkshopboitani.html |date=2012-10-13 }}''</ref> until it was merged with other departments in 2010 to form the Department of Biology and Biotechnology Charles Darwin.

Since 1973, he has devoted himself to the ecology and protection of [[wolf|wolves]]. He has developed more than 30 management plans for various national parks. Boitani is active in the Species Survival Commission of the World Conservation Union ([[IUCN]]) since 1996;<ref name="CSG Members">[https://www.canids.org/members IUCN/SSC Canid Specialist Group. Members.]</ref> he has been a member of its presidium since 2002;<ref name="CSG Members" /> and chairman of its group of specialists of the Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe.<ref>Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe [https://www.lcie.org/About-LCIE/-Who-are-we lcie.org]</ref> He has worked in numerous IUCN specialist groups.<ref>[https://www.iucn.org/theme/species/about/species-survival-commission/ssc-leadership-and-steering-committee/ssc-steering-committee-member-profiles SSC Steering Committee member profiles]</ref> In the ''Canid Specialist Group'' he is the coordinator of the Wolf in Europe working group.<ref name="CSG Members" /> Together with [[L. David Mech]], who was chairman of the IUCN Wolf Specialist Group from 1978 to 2013, Boitani published IUCN contributions on the subject of wolves, including the entry in the [[Red List of Threatened Species|Red List]].<ref name=IUCN>{{cite iucn |author=Boitani, L. |author2=Phillips, M. |author3=Jhala, Y. |year=2018 |errata=2020 |title=''Canis lupus'' |volume=2018 |article-number=e.T3746A163508960 |doi=10.2305/IUCN.UK.2018-2.RLTS.T3746A163508960.en |access-date=15 October 2020}}</ref> Several documents relevant to the [[European Commission]] on the management of large wild carnivores in Europe, in particular on wolf management, were produced under Boitani's leadership.<ref>European Commission: ''[https://ec.europa.eu/environment/nature/conservation/species/carnivores/index_en.htm Large carnivores in the EU - the Commission's activity on large carnivores]''</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Julia Koch |title=Fears As Predator Returns To Europe |date=30 April 2015 |url=http://www.spiegel.de/international/germany/luigi-boitani-on-the-return-of-the-wolf-to-europe-a-1028351.html |website=spiegel.de}}</ref>

In 2023, he was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Luigi Boitani|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Boitani_Luigi|work=Member|publisher=Academia Europaea|access-date=2024-10-28}}</ref>

In addition to his scientific activities, he is dedicated to the publication of popular scientific articles on nature and nature conservation in books, magazines, and television programs. In 2014, Boitani signed a cooperation agreement between the Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe and [[Rewilding Europe]].<ref>Rewilding Europe: ''[https://www.rewildingeurope.com/news/united-for-the-conservation-of-europes-large-carnivores/ United for the conservation of Europe's large carnivores]''</ref> In addition, Boitani is one of the six members of the Foundation Segré.<ref>Foundation Segré: ''[https://www.fondationsegre.org/people-and-structure/ People and Structure]''</ref>

== Books ==
* Luigi Boitani, Stefania Bartoli: ''The Macdonald Encyclopedia of Mammals''. Little Brown GBR, 1986, {{ISBN|0-356-12422-3}}.
* L. David Mech, Luigi Boitani: ''Wolves: Behavior, Ecology and Conservation''. University of Chicago Press, 2006, {{ISBN|0-226-51697-0}}.
* Luigi Boitani, Marco Musiani, Paul C. Paquet: ''World of Wolves – New Perspectives on Ecology, Behaviour, and Management – Energy, Ecology, and the Environment''. University of Calgary Press, 2010, {{ISBN|978-1-55238-269-1}}.
